changeSet.author: asr_deploy
changeSet.comment: Create customer summary view for APEX Customer Portal
changeSet.createView: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_EMAIL, c.CUSTOMER_PHONE, c.SOURCE_SYSTEM, c.LOAD_DATE, FN_CUSTOMER_STATUS(c.CUSTOMER_ID) AS DATA_STATUS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TGT_CUSTOMER_AUDIT a WHERE a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID) AS AUDIT_COUNT FROM TGT_CUSTOMER c
